title: Post to 5 platforms a day from one Claude Code command.
lead: Late + Claude Code + the /post-content skill. One video in. Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, X out. No Buffer. No scheduler. No VA.
inside: You'll have Late connected to all 5 socials, the Late MCP running in Claude Code, and your first video posted with /post-content.
what: One tool (Late) connects all your socials. One MCP install lets Claude Code talk to Late. One skill (/post-content) runs the whole publish loop end to end: transcribe, caption per platform, schedule, ship. You stop logging into five apps. You drop a video file, Claude transcribes it, writes platform-specific captions (because TikTok ≠ LinkedIn), and posts. Done in under two minutes.

Once it's connected you can post one video to IG Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts and X from the same prompt, get a custom caption per platform, schedule or queue or fire immediately, re-post old winners with a fresh caption in one line, and pull post analytics back into Claude to brief your next video. It replaces the 4 hours a week of cross-posting and re-formatting captions.
prereqs: A Late account (free tier works to test)
Your social accounts ready to auth: IG (Business or Creator), TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, X
IG on a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook page (2 minutes in the IG app if you're still on personal)
One short-form video you actually want to post (test run = real run)
warn: Late actually publishes. Wrong caption, broken link, scheduled at 3 AM, that's all live. Always preview the draft Claude generates before approving the publish step.

steps.p: One tool that posts to every platform you care about. Go to getlate.dev and sign up with Google or email. Create a workspace, one per brand, this is where every post lives. Then Settings, Developer, generate a personal API key. Copy it. You'll paste it once in step 3.

Inside Late, hit Connect Account and auth each platform once, top to bottom. Then verify: Late dashboard, Accounts tab, 5 green dots. If any are red or "Re-auth needed," fix it now. The MCP won't recover later if a platform is half-connected.
steps.code:
1. Instagram   (Business/Creator account, needs a linked FB page)
2. TikTok      (Personal or Business both work)
3. LinkedIn    (Personal profile OR company page, your call)
4. YouTube     (Channel auth via Google)
5. X           (OAuth, takes ~10 seconds)

steps.p: One command. Claude can now read your Late workspace and create posts. No restart needed, MCPs hot-load. To confirm, open any Claude Code session and ask "list my Late accounts". Expect 5 platforms back. If you get zero, the key didn't paste cleanly. Run claude mcp list and re-add.
steps.code:
claude mcp add late
# Paste the API key from Step 01 when prompted.

steps.p: One command. Five platforms. Claude transcribes the video with Whisper, writes a custom caption per platform, shows you the draft, and on approval ships it to Late. Late publishes to IG, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.

prompts.h: Post now with your own hook
prompts.code:
/post-content video.mp4
Use this hook for all 5 captions: "I stopped paying a VA $800/mo. Here's why."

prompts.h: Schedule for tomorrow 9 AM, skip X
prompts.code:
/post-content video.mp4 schedule="tomorrow 09:00"
platforms="ig,tiktok,linkedin,youtube"
Stagger posts by 5 minutes so the algos don't cross-pollinate.

Find my top 3 Reels from the last 30 days.
Rewrite the hooks. Re-queue to Late for next week, one per day at 10 AM.
